title: 8-Week Match Duration Engine
overview: The follow-on from Match Conditioning. Designed to push your work-capacity ceiling: longer high-quality rallies, higher average intensity across sessions, and matched-duration efforts that mirror a full match.
outcome: Able to maintain point quality deep into the third set, faster recovery between points, and better tolerance for long matches.

phases.title: Adaptation
phases.guidance: New movement patterns at moderate load. Priority is clean technique and tolerance, not volume.

phases.title: Ramp
phases.guidance: Add load only where week-2 technique was clean. Keep rest generous between main lifts.

phases.title: Throwback Test Week
phases.guidance: Rerun one week of Match Conditioning. The baseline volumes should feel easier now — this is the test.

phases.title: Consolidation
phases.guidance: Return to the new block. Build toward target loads and sharper outputs — intensity over volume.

phases.title: Benchmark
phases.guidance: Repeat a single high-quality session per theme to compare against week 2. Log a persistence check.

days.title: High-Intensity Repeats
days.focus: Repeat high-intensity intervals with tight rest.
days.objective: Train repeat sprint with match-intensity work-to-rest ratio.
days.warmup: Jog 8 min, dynamic stretch, 4 x 20m strides.

exercises.title: 30-second hard / 60-second easy
exercises.intent: Near-VO2max intervals.
howTo: Run hard for 30 seconds at ~90% effort.
Jog easy for 60 seconds.
Repeat for 10 rounds.
exercises.tennisWhy: A standard point is 5-10 seconds of work; a long rally is 20-30. Training at rally-length intensity directly mirrors match stress.
watchOuts: If rep 8+ slows by more than 20%, cut the workout.
Don't walk the rest — jog.
exercises.intentTr: VO2max civarı aralıklar.
howToTr: 30 saniye ~%90 efor ile sert koş.
60 saniye rahat koş.
10 tur tekrar et.
exercises.tennisWhyTr: Standart bir puan 5-10 saniye iştir; uzun bir rally 20-30 saniye. Rally uzunluğunda yoğunlukta çalışmak maç stresini doğrudan yansıtır.
watchOutsTr: Tekrar 8+ zamanı %20'den fazla yavaşladıysa antrenmanı bitir.
Dinlenmede yürüme — jog et.

days.finisher: 5-min easy cooldown jog.

days.title: Tempo + Core
days.objective: Sustained effort at threshold pace with anti-rotation core.
days.warmup: Jog 5 min, activations.

exercises.title: Tempo run
exercises.intent: Sustained threshold work.
howTo: Run at a pace you could hold for about 45 minutes — comfortably hard.
No bursts, no slowing — steady output.
exercises.tennisWhy: Between-point walks are your recovery windows. Tempo work raises the pace at which you can recover, so you recover more in less time.
watchOuts: Start slightly slower than you think.
Stop if form collapses.
exercises.intentTr: Eşik temposu sürekli iş.
howToTr: Yaklaşık 45 dakika koruyabileceğin tempoda koş — rahat-zor.
Patlama yok, yavaşlama yok — sabit çıktı.
exercises.tennisWhyTr: Puanlar arası yürüyüşler senin toparlanma pencerelerindir. Tempo işi toparlanabildiğin tempoyu yükseltir, böylece daha kısa sürede daha çok toparlanırsın.
watchOutsTr: Düşündüğünden biraz yavaş başla.
Form bozulursa dur.

exercises.title: Side plank with rotation
exercises.intent: Anti-lateral core under fatigue.
howTo: Set up in a side plank.
Rotate the top arm under your body and back up.
Keep hips square to avoid sagging.
exercises.tennisWhy: The core fatigues late in matches. Strengthening it under rotation under fatigue protects shot quality in hour 2.
watchOuts: Quality over quantity — stop when hips sag.
Slow tempo.
exercises.intentTr: Yorgunluk altında anti-lateral kor.
howToTr: Yan plank'a kur.
Üstteki kolu vücudun altından ve geri çevir.
Sarkmamak için kalçaları eşit tut.
exercises.tennisWhyTr: Kor maçların geç saatlerinde yorulur. Rotasyon altında yorgunken güçlendirmek 2. saatte vuruş kalitesini korur.
watchOutsTr: Miktardan önce kalite — kalçalar sarktığında dur.
Yavaş tempo.

days.finisher: Dead bug 3 x 8.

days.title: Match-Duration Effort
days.objective: Simulate the duration and variability of a match.
days.warmup: Jog 10 min, dynamic stretch.

exercises.title: Varied-pace bike or run
exercises.intent: Match-length capacity.
howTo: Alternate 3 min moderate, 1 min hard, 2 min easy.
Repeat the block for 45 minutes.
Don't drop to walking on 'easy' — just easy.
exercises.tennisWhy: A match is a 2-3 hour piece of varied intensity. Building the capacity to sustain varied effort for match length is the single clearest win.
watchOuts: If you can't hold the block, shorten to 30 min and build up.
Stop if any form breakdown appears — this is a capacity build, not a grind.
exercises.titleTr: Değişken Tempolu Bisiklet ya da Koşu
exercises.intentTr: Maç uzunluğunda kapasite.
howToTr: 3 dakika orta, 1 dakika sert, 2 dakika rahat dönüşümlü.
Bloğu 45 dakika tekrarla.
'Rahat'ta yürüyüşe düşme — sadece rahat.
exercises.tennisWhyTr: Bir maç 2-3 saatlik değişken yoğunluklu bir parçadır. Maç uzunluğunda değişken efora dayanma kapasitesi en net kazançtır.
watchOutsTr: Bloğu tutamıyorsan 30 dakikaya indir ve çık.
Formda bozulma olursa dur — bu kapasite inşası, dayanma testi değil.
